7–12 V DC jack or USB-A in
(stand-alone DFPlayer keys, not read by the ESP32)
blue LED and is a boot strap pin
J1 GND and VIN− are one net, so the
12 V supply shares the ESP32 ground
All GND symbols are one common net (MB102 GND rail, ESP32 GND, DFPlayer GND, HW-517 J1 GND / VIN−, PIR GND). +5V = MB102 rail set to 5 V.
Inferred from firmware + photos 2026-10-25. Which button is on IO1 vs IO2, and the rail voltage jumpers, are not verified.
